Class JSONUtilsTest

@IsTest
private class JSONUtilsTest

Test class for JSONUtils. Validates JSON parsing, SObject mapping, array notation support, type conversions, and JSON generation functionality. Tests both JSONRecord reading/writing capabilities and SObjectExtended mapping with transformations, defaults, and cross-reference lookups.

public static String getJSONString()

Returns a sample JSON string for testing purposes. Contains nested objects, arrays, various data types, and supports testing of path notation and array indexing features.

Returns:
    JSON string with envelope structure containing product details, brand info, dates, and collections.

@IsTest
private static void testJSONRecordAsReader()

Tests JSONRecord as a JSON reader/parser. Validates containsField(), get(), getAs*() type conversion methods, nested path navigation, array notation support (e.g., "envelope/tags[2]"), and object deserialization.

@IsTest
private static void testJSONRecordAsWriter()

Tests JSONRecord as a JSON writer/builder. Validates put() method for adding fields with nested path notation, getAsMap() for retrieving the internal map, and serialize() for JSON string generation.

@IsTest
private static void testSObjectExtended1()

Tests SObjectExtended constructors and fixed-value setter methods. Validates all three constructors, putFixed*() methods for various data types, prefix support for external IDs, and null value handling.

@IsTest
private static void testSObjectExtended2()

Tests SObjectExtended with MappingField-based value mapping. Validates putValue() method with various field mappings (boolean, datetime, date, decimal, string), cross-reference lookups, default values, and null value handling.
